content.summary: Research findings for: Anthropic claude-agent-sdk tool calls stuck running

data.original_input: Tool calls in the Anthropic agents SDK integration stay in running status until the session ends, then they are marked aborted. Hypothesis: SDK not emitting streaming tool updates or OpenCode not handling them.
codebase_findings: LLM stream path for providerID claude-agent-sdk bypasses ai-sdk and uses streamClaudeNative (packages/opencode/src/session/llm.ts).

streamClaudeNative maps SDK messages via processSDKMessage; tool completion only emitted on tool_use_summary when summary is present and no tool-error path is emitted (packages/opencode/src/provider/native/claude-agent-sdk.ts).

SessionProcessor marks tool parts running on tool-call and expects tool-result/tool-error to finish; at stream end it marks any pending/running tool as error 'Tool execution aborted' (packages/opencode/src/session/processor.ts).

translate-stream has more robust tool handling: emits tool-result even if summary missing, emits tool-error on is_error, and pulls ToolMetadataRegistry for rich metadata (packages/opencode/src/provider/sdk/claude-agent-sdk/translate-stream.ts).

tool-bridge uses ToolMetadataRegistry because SDK tool handlers often do not receive tool_use_id, so metadata is keyed by (toolName, input) for later retrieval (packages/opencode/src/provider/sdk/claude-agent-sdk/tool-bridge.ts, packages/opencode/src/provider/sdk/claude-agent-sdk/tool-metadata-registry.ts).
MessageV2 converts pending/running tool parts to error output in model messages to avoid dangling tool_use blocks (packages/opencode/src/session/message-v2.ts).
patterns: Tool status lifecycle: tool-input-start -> tool-call (running) -> tool-result/tool-error (completed).
If completion events never arrive, SessionProcessor marks tool parts as aborted at stream end.
Native claude-agent-sdk stream handling is less complete than translate-stream and likely diverged over time.
raw_options: Emit tool-result on tool_use_summary even when summary is missing; also emit tool-error when is_error/error present, mirroring translate-stream.
Reuse ToolMetadataRegistry in native stream path to populate tool result metadata/attachments and improve tool completion fidelity.
Handle tool_use_summary/tool_progress payload variants (tool_use_ids, is_error) and default output text to close tool calls.
Port translate-stream tool handling into native stream path (shared helper) to avoid drift.
Switch claude-agent-sdk streaming to use the ai-sdk LanguageModel (createClaudeAgentSDK) instead of streamClaudeNative.
Add temporary logging of raw SDK message payloads to confirm which tool events are emitted and with which fields.
